claims.quoted_text: So, let's assume all 10 cats with black fur catch mice, then the number of cats that do not catch mice and have black fur will be 0.
claims.explanation: This is impossible because only 7 cats in total catch mice (24 - 17 = 7). At most 7 of the 10 black cats can catch mice, so at least 10 - 7 = 3 black cats must be among the 17 that do not catch mice. The minimum is 3, not 0.
